parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A client-generated unique key per logical submit (a UUID; 1-128 printable ASCII characters). Clients must always send it on POST /standards: a retry carrying the same key, method, path and an identical body replays the original stored response (with the response header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`) instead of re-executing the create; the same key with a different method, path or body is rejected with 409 idempotency-key-reused, a missing key is a 400 idempotency-key-required and a malformed one a 400 idempotency-key-invalid. Postgres is the only runtime, so the check is on in every deployment.
